title: Design System: Astilba Authentication & Shared Controls

headline.purpose: Compact auth task heading at the approved 24px default; provisional system sans.

body.purpose: Status, explanation and general auth copy.

secondary.purpose: Recovery, back and secondary links; muted guidance.

input-sm.purpose: Resolved shared-control typography; inherits the surrounding font context.

control-action.purpose: Resolved shared-control typography; inherits the surrounding font context.

control-input.purpose: Resolved shared-control typography; inherits the surrounding font context.

control-input-sm.purpose: Resolved shared-control typography; inherits the surrounding font context.

control-body.purpose: Shared feedback body text; inherits the auth system stack inside AuthFrame.

shadows.name: menu-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-theme floating menu elevation and inset highlights.

motion.name: input-hover
motion.purpose: Input, Select and Textarea borders share button and menu-item timing. Focus outlines appear immediately in their final colour to avoid a text-colour flash. Reduced motion disables transitions; theme capture temporarily overrides them.

motion.name: menu-easing
motion.purpose: Decelerating menu motion; easings.menu. Reduced motion disables transitions.

motion.name: theme-change
motion.purpose: One browser snapshot crossfade for explicit and system theme changes. Suppress individual transitions during capture; reduced motion and unsupported browsers switch immediately.

motion.name: button-hover
motion.purpose: Shared Button/IconButton fill, border, text and outline transitions; theme timing overrides while switching.

motion.name: menu-item-hover
motion.purpose: Highlighted menu backgrounds use the shared button timing in both directions; outlines remain immediate. Reduced motion disables the transition.

motion.name: tooltip-open
motion.purpose: Tooltip opacity and 0.98-scale entrance via durations.tooltip.open and easings.out, after the provider’s 300ms hover delay.

motion.name: tooltip-close
motion.purpose: Tooltip exit via durations.tooltip.close, without an added delay. Base UI instant states, reduced motion and theme capture disable transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Shared primary recipe, md size; data-size=sm selects the 40px minimum. Uses the surrounding semantic palette.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Shared secondary recipe, md size; data-size=sm selects the 40px minimum. Uses the surrounding semantic palette.

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Shared danger recipe, md size; data-size=sm selects the 40px minimum. Uses the surrounding semantic palette.

components.description: Shared field border in the auth palette, meeting 3:1 on the standard surface. Focus has a flush 2px visual edge; explicit invalid state retains error colour.

components.name: Underlined Link
components.description: Default inline link treatment, shared by native and typed router links. Keyboard focus uses the shared neutral interactive-border token. The 2px radii.xs token softens focus corners.

components.name: Plain Link
components.description: No underline at rest; hover reveals the underline. Keyboard focus remains visible. Keyboard focus uses the shared neutral interactive-border token. The 2px radii.xs token softens focus corners.

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Sidebar link with active-route colour, weight and padding. Keyboard focus uses the shared neutral interactive-border token.

components.name: Appearance Icon Button
components.description: Base UI button with a square ghost recipe, accessible name, and 40px target. Ghost hover/open uses a light neutral fill and the shared button colour transition.

components.name: Appearance Menu
components.description: Static preview of the Base UI radio menu. Live component supplies keyboard control, dismissal and focus restoration. Opens over 250ms from 0.97 scale; closes over 150ms to 0.99. Reduced motion is instant. Token-based 12px popup/8px item radii, 6px padding, 13px text, 8px icon gap and 32px minimum rows. Layered theme-specific shadows and neutral hover fills. Menu icons are 16px; the trigger keeps its 20px default. Theme selection keeps the menu open. Item highlights use the shared 200ms button hover timing, with immediate keyboard outlines.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Pill-shaped supplementary label sharing the menu surface, foreground, 13px type and shadow. Opens after a 300ms hover delay with a 150ms fade/0.98 scale; closes over 50ms without a delay. Keyboard focus, Base UI instant states and reduced motion skip transitions. Live triggers retain their own accessible name.

components.name: Inline Field Error
components.description: Base UI associates a persistent inline error with its control. Errors appear after submit and revalidate during correction; the recipe uses semantic error colour and secondary type.

narrative.overview:
A familiar, focused entry to Astilba: a compact form on an open surface, with a shared starting edge and an unmistakable primary action. The owner selected Aligned stack. Consistent grouping, consistent field outlines and visible focus supply structure without an outer card.

The auth visual direction covers AuthFrame and its sign-in, MFA, reset, invitation and conditional hosted-signup flows. Shared control recipes also apply across the application; auth supplies local palette overrides rather than separate control styling. The signed-in dashboard retains its existing green identity. Recording shared control defaults does not approve or redesign its other styles. Product truth remains in ../../PRODUCT.md; the auth system font and logo lettering remain provisional. The auth logo is temporarily omitted at the owner’s request; the heading starts the column.

Password recovery shows one stage at a time: account email, a privacy-preserving check-email confirmation, then the new-password form opened from `/reset?token=…`. The code stays out of the form. The field label is “New password”, without a requirements list. Reset uses the same shared fields and start-aligned secondary links as sign-in. The only secondary action is “Back to sign in”. Invalid links show an inline error, failed submissions retain the password draft, and completion confirms the change before returning to sign-in. Stage transitions focus the heading.

Workspace invitations open `/invitation?token=…`; sign-in has no invitation prompt. Without a token, the page directs users to their invitation email. New accounts enter their name and password in shared fields; signed-in users confirm acceptance without re-entering credentials. The sign-in link preserves the invitation URL so existing accounts can return after authentication. Successful acceptance removes the form, focuses “Workspace joined”, and offers “Open projects”. Invalid links show an inline error and failed submissions retain the draft.

Appearance uses a shared icon button, tooltip and Light/Dark/System radio menu. System follows OS appearance changes live; explicit preferences persist. Auth palette classes also style portalled popups.

Sign-in keeps the credential fields together in native focus order: Skip to content, Appearance, Email, Password, Show/Hide password, Forgot password, Sign in. Recovery stays beside the password label visually; Field renders its labelAction after the full control and uses grid placement for that label-row position. The skip link bypasses Appearance so the next Tab reaches Email; no positive tabindex or automatic field focus is used.

Link focus outlines use the shared neutral interactive-border role in both themes. Skip to content uses foreground text on the shared surface and the same link focus outline, including outside AuthFrame.

Sign-in/MFA, reset and invitation forms use Base UI with synchronous Zod validation. Inline errors use the semantic error colour and secondary type; submission focuses the first invalid field, correction revalidates, and failed drafts remain. Auth messages are injected into schema construction from the current i18next catalogue. Non-migrated forms retain native validation.

Dark-mode errors use the shared #ff7b7b red for text and invalid input edges, with 7.47:1 contrast on #121212. Light-mode error colours remain unchanged. Error messages provide visible text in addition to colour. Portalled menu and tooltip positioners use viewport-fixed positioning so resizing cannot leave a stale horizontal scroll area in WebKit.

Language uses the shared globe IconButton, Tooltip and radio Menu beside Appearance in auth. English remains the only released language; development additionally exposes expanded-text and RTL pseudolocale previews. The menu is hidden in production while only one released language is available. Switching language preserves drafts, password visibility, focus and validation state; visible errors update without reviving cleared errors. HTML direction and Base UI direction stay aligned. Field content and menu items may wrap; layouts use logical properties. Emails/codes remain LTR and embedded identifiers are isolated. Routes and invitation/reset tokens do not change with language.
keyCharacteristics: Open white or cool-navy auth surface with a narrow aligned column.
Reusable Base UI and native controls with semantic variants and consistent focus states.
Persistent busy and error feedback with native form behaviour.

rules.name: The Auth Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep the cool-neutral palette inside AuthFrame. Shared control recipes use semantic roles; field interaction edges use grey throughout, while action and brand defaults remain green elsewhere.

rules.name: The Control State Rule
rules.body: Let recipes own idle, hover, focus and invalid states. All fields use the shared control.border token; compound controls can supply the hover override.

rules.name: The Open Surface Rule
rules.body: Group auth content through alignment and spacing, with no outer card padding, border, radius or shadow.

dos: Do reuse Button, Input, Select, Textarea, Checkbox, Label, Link and Anchor, with Field and BusyButton for form behaviour.
Do use registered tokens, semantic colour roles and logical CSS properties for control styling.
Do preserve native labels, keyboard interaction, autofill, error association, reduced motion and forced-colour states.
Do keep hosted-only actions conditional and preserve the same auth identity on self-hosted installations.
Do treat the auth interface font and logo lettering as provisional.
Use Base UI for custom interactive widgets and preserve native HTML semantics for simple controls.
Use the same minimum-3:1 field border for inputs, passwords, OTP slots, selects and textareas.
donts: Don't apply the auth palette to the dashboard as an automatic consistency fix.
Don't style native inputs or buttons through route descendant selectors; change shared recipes or semantic tokens.
Don't use Apfel Grotezk, restore the outer auth card or introduce dark input underlines.
